Revival of Kolleru lake
*261. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
Kolleru lake on the East Coast of Andhra
Pradesh was one of the major wintering
points for Siberian Cranes and other birds
from the Northern Regions and the Tundra;
(b) whether illegal encroachments and
corporate fish farming have destroyed
thousands of acres of the habitat in Kolleru;
(c) whether Government has assigned
the Bombay Natural History Museum or
some other noted institution to study and
suggest urgent measures to revive and
restore this lake as the major wintering point
for lakhs of birds and other avian species;
and
(d) if so, the special measures proposed
to be taken?

to put a cap on the exorbitant prices being
charged by the private operators?

Will the Minister of MINES be pleased to

Implementation of GoM's
recommendation on power reforms
†*265. SHRI JAI PRAKASH: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that action on the
implementation of the recommendations
made by the sub-committee of Group of
Ministers (GoM) constituted for power
reforms is being delayed; and
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to achieve the target of one
lakh megawatt power generation during the
Twelfth Five Year Plan period and to raise
the required funds for these power plants
to be installed during the above period?
Environment approval to POSCO
project
*266. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the panel set
up by the Ministry to probe all
environmental approvals granted to the
POSCO project, the implementation of the
Forest Rights Act and resettlement and
rehabilitation provisions, has submitted its
reports and if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether all the members of panel
were unanimous in their recommendations;
and
(c) if not, what are the areas of
differences and the action proposed to be
taken in the matter?
Annual reports and audited accounts
of MAEF
*267. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the annual
reports and audited accounts of the
Maulana Azad Education Foundation
(MAEF) are required to be laid in the
Parliament;
(b) if so, the financial years in respect
of which such reports have been laid, so
far;
(c) the financial years in respect of
which the reports have not been laid, so
far, along with the reasons therefor;
(d) by when the same is likely to be
done; and
(e) the action being taken to revamp the
system?
Opening of Aditya Solar Shops
†*268. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of NEW AND RENEWABLE ENERGY
be pleased to state:

82
(a) whether Aditya Solar Shops have
been opened to sell solar energy related
products in Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the details thereof, city-wise;
(c) the norms and guidelines laid by
Government for implementation of this
Scheme;
(d) whether there is any proposal to
open more such shops in the country and
in Maharashtra; and
(e) the expenditure incurred by
Government so far since the beginning of
this Scheme and the details of the funds
provided to Maharashtra during the last
three years?
Confidentiality of bid documents
*269. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently
Andhra Pradesh Government has released
a bid document for procurement of 2,000
MW long-term power;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that there
had been a subversion of the standard
bidding guidelines issued by the Ministry
for the bid documents with regard to
ensuring confidentiality of the bid
documents;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken by the Central
Government to ensure that the bid
documents are submitted as prescribed in
the standard guidelines?
Legislation against sexual and
physical harassment of women
*270. SHRIMA TI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
bring a legislation to protect women against
sexual and physical harassment;
(b) if so, the details of the salient features
of the Bill;
(c) whether the Union Cabinet has
cleared the Bill; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and by when
this Bill is likely to be enacted?
Implementation of IFRS accounting
system
*271. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry would be able
to implement International Financial
Reporting Standards (IFRS) accounting
system in the country by internationallly
committed deadline of April, 2011;
(b) what are the possible roadblocks in
meeting the deadline;
(c) whether the banking sector has
expressed specific reservation in
implementing IFRS;
(d) the steps taken by Government to
address these issues; and
(e) the percentage of public companies
in India that are aleady reporting in IFRS?
BRT Wildlife Sanctuary
*272. DR. VIJAY MALLY A: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has submitted a request for
declaring Biligiri Rangaswamy Temple
(BRT) Wildlife Sanctuary as a Tiger
Reserve, since 2005;
(b) whether additional information
desired by the Central Government was

2009; and
(c) by when the Ministry's approval in
this regard is expected?
Special package for Uttarakhand
†*273. SHRI BHAGAT SINGH
KOSHYARI: Will the Minister of NEW
AND RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased
to state:
(a) whether any proposal is under
consideration to provide special package
or subsidy for development of wind, solar
or other alternative energy sources, in view
of specific environmental significance and
difficult terrain of the border State
Uttarakhand;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether, it being a hill State, any
proposal is under consideration for a
separate policy or a special package or
subsidy for power generation through
environmental friendly techniques from
some sugarcane pulp, pine leaves and rice
husk; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Allocation of power to North-Eastern
States
*274. SHRI KHEKIHO ZHIMOMI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether any extra consideration was
given to the North-Eastern States in
allocation of power from Central,
Generation Stations or power plants;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is a fact that there is a big
gap between supply and demand of power
in the North-Eastern States;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the State Government of
Nagaland has requested the Central
Government for allocation of additional
power to the State; and
(f) whether the request was considered
and if so, the decision in that regard?
Infrastructure improvement in MCDs
*275. SHRI VIJAY JAW AHARLAL
DARDA: Will the Minister of MINORITY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Bihar
Government has conveyed its concern to
the Central Government for lagging behind
in schemes for improvement of
infrastructure in State's seven Minority
Concentration Districts (MCDs) in
upgrading educational facilities for the
minorities;
(b) if so, whether the other States have
been able to upgrade educational facilities
for minorities in MCDs;
(c) if so, the details of the States and
Union Territories which have implemented
infrastructure improvement schemes; and
(d) the status thereof in Maharashtra,
Jammu and Kashmir, Uttar Pradesh and
Kerala?

TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Scheduled Tribes and

Setting up of new power plants
*277. SHRI M.P. ACHUTHAN: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry is actively
considering to set up new power plants in
the country;

(c) whether the proposed plants are

start electricity generation?
Illegal mining
†*278. SHRI BALA V ANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether illegal mining work is going
on in several parts of the country;
(b) if so, the details of such reported
cases;
(c) the details of the estimated loss to
the exchequer due to illegal mining;
(d) whether the Central Government
has requested the State Governments to
set up State level Coordination-cum-
Empowered Committees and prepare
action plan to deal with illegal mining; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and the
response received from the State
Governments in this regard and the steps
taken to check illegal mining?

Mundra SEZ
*279. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has noticed
irregularities pertaining to the
environmental laws in the construction of
Mundra Special Economic Zone (SEZ);
(b) if so, the steps taken by
Government; and
(c) whether public hearing was
conducted before starting construction?
Polluting industrial units between
Kannauj and Varanasi
†*280. SHRI MOTI LAL VORA: Will
the Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:

Control Board (CPCB) itself has decided
to take action against the industrial units
causing pollution between Kannauj and

(b) if so, by when the steps would be
taken by CPCB in this direction and the
pollution level of 170 factories situated
between Kannauj an Varanasi would be
brought under control?
